alex_ng: Quick RFC follow-up about wiring bench prober errors into onboarding metrics. I sketched a minimal contract where the prober emits structured failure events and the bench aggregator consumes them and updates both counters and traces. Want to align on fields and cardinality tradeoffs.

maria_k: +1. can you paste that minimal contract?

alex_ng: sure — rough idea:
```json
{
  "model_id": "string",
  "probe_id": "string",
  "timestamp": "iso",
  "outcome": "ok|fail|warn",
  "error_code": "string", // short taxonomy, e.g. "kv_mismatch", "oom"
  "severity": "low|medium|high",
  "sample_input_id": "optional string",
  "debug_blob": "optional url or s3 path"
}
```

jon_b: I like keeping error_code small and stable. main tradeoff: do we emit a metric per error_code (high cardinality) or label reasons on a single counter?

diane_r: cardinality is the main worry for Prom. If we expect hundreds of unique error codes per model we should not label by model+code in prometheus. Instead: emit low-cardinality counters (ok, fail, degrade) + histogram of latency + event stream (Kafka) for detailed diagnostics.

alex_ng: agreed. plan: prometheus -> low-card counters and histograms; event log -> structured events with full error_code and debug_blob. bench aggregator will sample events to attach to model onboarding records.

maria_k: what about rollbacks / admit gating? we need a deterministic signal the gate can consume (pass/fail + reasons).

jon_b: suggest an admit API that returns: { verdict: pass|fail|defer, reasons: [error_code...], evidence_url: s3 } — keep small and versioned. gate only reads verdict + top-1 reason.

alex_ng: agree. also need to handle flaky probes: aggregator should do windowed dedupe and weight by sample count. otherwise a single flaky probe can fail the gate.

diane_r: +1, implement a sliding window (10m) and require >=N failing probes in window before flagging. Default N=3.

prober-bot: prober v0.3 deployed to staging; emitted 9 failures for model:rmx-13b on latest smoke set. Sample evidence: https://ci.internal/reports/4770011222/summary

maria_k: nice — can we tag failures with deterministic fingerprints so dedupe is cheap? e.g. fingerprint = sha1(model_id + probe_id + short_error_code + trace_hash)

jon_b: yes. fingerprint in event contract makes dedupe easy. don't expose full trace in metric label.

alex_ng: open question: should the bench aggregator normalize error_code names (map vendor-specific strings to canonical codes)? That gives consistent gating but adds a mapping layer.

diane_r: long-term, yes. short-term, let prober emit canonical codes. onboarding infra can maintain a mapping table that producers update when onboarding new vendors. mapping updates must be versioned and applied at ingest.

maria_k: infra work: define prometheus metric names and labels. Proposal: `redwood_onboard_probe_total{outcome="fail"}` and `redwood_onboard_probe_latency_seconds` histogram. Keep labels to: outcome, region, run_type. No model or probe-specific labels.

jon_b: for the event stream use topic `onboard.prober.events.v1`. schema = the JSON above + fingerprint. Avro or protobuf? protobuf for strictness + easy client gen.

alex_ng: action items:
- alex_ng: write short RFC blurb with contract + sample events (due EOD Tue)
- maria_k: draft prometheus name list and gating usage (due Wed)
- jon_b: prototype protobuf schema and emitter in rust client (POC this week)
- diane_r: add sliding-window dedupe + threshold logic to bench aggregator (PR next).

maria_k: one more: breakglass — if evidence_url missing, gate should defer rather than fail. Avoid false negatives.

alex_ng: yes — gate verdict priority: pass > defer > fail. defer requires manual review.

jon_b: ok. i'll start proto and post link. thanks all :thumbsup:

prober-bot: NOTE: automated deploy message — bench-prober v0.3 rolled to staging at 2026-03-20T15:12Z

diane_r: cool. we'll sync on the RFC thread once alex posts.

alex_ng: thanks, closing here for now. we can reconvene if any of the action owners hit major blockers. :rocket:
